definitions.gloss: commuting to school, going to school
definitions.explanation: The act of traveling regularly to school.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{電車|でんしゃ}で{通学|つうがく}している。
examples.english: I commute to school by train every day.

examples.japanese: {通学|つうがく}に{一時間|いちじかん}かかる。
examples.english: It takes one hour to commute to school.

examples.japanese: {通学|つうがく}{路|ろ}は{安全|あんぜん}ですか。
examples.english: Is the route to school safe?

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{通学|つうがく}する (to commute to school)
・〜で{通学|つうがく}する (to commute to school by ~)
・{通学|つうがく}に〜かかる (it takes ~ to commute to school)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{通学|つうがく}{路|ろ} (route to school)
・{通学|つうがく}{定期|ていき} (student commuter pass)
・{通学|つうがく}{時間|じかん} (commute time to school)
・{徒歩|とほ}{通学|つうがく} (walking to school)
・{自転車|じてんしゃ}{通学|つうがく} (cycling to school)

RELATED WORD:
・{通勤|つうきん}: Commuting to work (same pattern, different destination)
